mapper.select: SELECT l.*, t.name AS tenant_name, u.real_name AS real_name FROM ${log.database}.sys_login_log l LEFT JOIN ${log.database}.sys_tenant t ON t.id = l.tenant_id LEFT JOIN ${log.database}.sys_user u ON u.id = l.user_id WHERE l.id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ${log.database}.sys_login_log WHERE id IS NOT NULL
